programme.title: A Body in the Basement

programme.desc: S10 E19 — Planet of the Daleks: Episode 5 Desperate to prevent the Daleks from releasing their plague, the Doctor, Jo and the Thals infiltrate their base. But the Daleks detect the intruders!
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E20 — Planet of the Daleks: Episode 6 A force of ten thousand Daleks is coming to life below the surface of Spiridon. The Doctor and the Thals must find a way to defeat the Daleks before they invade the galaxy.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E21 — The Green Death: Episode 1 In Wales, a dead miner is found glowing green. UNIT investigates and Jo empathises with the environmentalism of Cliff Jones who is opposing the pollution from Global Chemicals.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E22 — The Green Death: Episode 2 Investigating the old mine workings, Jo and miner, Bert, become trapped beneath the surface when the lift is sabotaged. Bert touches some green slime and becomes infected.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E23 — The Green Death: Episode 3 The Doctor and Jo discover the mine’s terrible secret. Global Chemicals’ managing director, Stevens is determined that they won’t live to reveal what they have learnt.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E24 — The Green Death: Episode 4 The Brigadier attempts to seal the giant maggots in the mine with explosives, but this only results in the creatures burrowing to the surface.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E25 — The Green Death: Episode 5 Captain Mike Yates is taken over by the super computer, BOSS and ordered to kill the Doctor. Cliff and Jo are trapped by the maggots as UNIT launch their attack.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S10 E26 — The Green Death: Episode 6 In the final episode Jones is struck down with the deadly virus and the Doctor uses the Metebelis crystal to break the computer's hold over Stevens.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E1 — The Time Warrior: Part 1 UNIT investigates when scientists go missing kidnapped by an alien trapped in the 13th Century. Travelling back in time in the TARDIS, the Doctor is unaware that he has stowaway.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E2 — The Time Warrior: Part 2 The Doctor discovers that the alien is a Sontaran warrior called Linx who is trying to repair his spaceship. Sarah is convinced that the Doctor is responsible for the abductions.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E3 — The Time Warrior: Part 3 Linx is providing advanced weaponry to Irongron and his men who prepare to attack Sir Edward’s castle. The Doctor is forced to improvise a defence, but will it be enough?
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E4 — The Time Warrior: Part 4 As the repairs to Linx’s spaceship are completed and he prepares to take off, the Doctor races to save the captured scientists and to prevent the course of history being changed.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E5 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 1 The Doctor and Sarah return in the TARDIS to present day London but are mystified when they find the city completely deserted.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E6 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 2 The Doctor plans to capture a dinosaur so that he can discover who is transporting them through time. But Mike Yates is in league with the enemy and is ordered to stop the Doctor.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E7 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 3 The Doctor has captured a Tyrannosaurus Rex but the conspirators don’t intend for it to remain captive for long. Sarah follows a lead but places herself in the hands of the enemy.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E8 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 4 Sarah awakens to discover that she is on a spaceship that left Earth months ago and is heading for a new world. The Doctor is framed for causing the return of the dinosaurs.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E9 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 5 Sarah discovers that the spaceship passengers are all victims of a deception, but not all are willing to believe her story.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E10 — Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 6 Dinosaurs are appearing all over London in a last effort to frighten people away as Professor Whitaker prepares to initiated ‘Operation Golden Age’.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E11 — Death to the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS suffers a power drain and is forced down on the planet Exxilon. Sarah is captured by the primitive inhabitants and the Doctor comes face to face with his oldest enemies.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E12 — Death to the Daleks: Part 2 The Daleks weaponry is rendered useless by the power drain and they are forced to make a truce with the Doctor and the members of the expedition from Earth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E13 — Death to the Daleks: Part 3 The Daleks force the Exillons to work as slave labour to mine the life saving parrinium. The Doctor and Bellal brave the puzzles and traps of the Exxilon city.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E14 — Death to the Daleks: Part 4 The Doctor and Bellal arrive at the centre of the Exxilon city but the Daleks are preparing to depart and launch a deadly plague missile that will kill everyone left behind.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E15 — The Monster of Peladon: Part 1 The Doctor makes a return visit to Peladon some years after his previous visit. There he discovers that several miners have died and the ghost of Aggedor is to blame.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E16 — The Monster of Peladon: Part 2 Chancellor Ortron accuses the Doctor and Sarah of being in league with the rebel miners and sentences them to be punished by Aggedor himself.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E17 — The Monster of Peladon: Part 3 Desperate to avoid a revolt from the miners, the Doctor attempts to expose the fraud of Aggedor’s ghost. Alpha Centauri has summoned Federation troops, but whose side are they on?
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E18 — The Monster of Peladon: Part 4 The Ice Warriors have taken control of Peladon. Pretending to cooperate, the Doctor concocts a plan to defeat the invaders.

programme.desc: S11 E21 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 1 The Doctor receives a mysterious package from his old companion, Jo Grant. Sarah joins Mike Yates to investigate sinister events at a Buddhist meditation centre.

programme.desc: S11 E22 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 2 Lupton, now under the control of a giant spider, infiltrates UNIT HQ and steals the Metebelis crystal. But the Doctor is unwilling to give it up so easily and a chase begins.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E23 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 3 Following Lupton, Sarah is transported to Metebelis 3 where she is captured by the human villagers. The Doctor uses the TARDIS to follow Sarah, but the spiders are waiting.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E24 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 4 With the Doctor in a coma, his only hope of survival lies with a device inside the TARDIS. Sarah is captured by the spiders and is held prisoner in their larder.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E25 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 5 Sarah makes a bargain with the Queen Spider and returns to Earth with the Doctor in the TARDIS. There they meet K’anpo, the Doctor’s Time Lord guru who has the Metebelis crystal.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S11 E26 — Planet of the Spiders: Part 6 The Doctor takes the blue crystal and returns to Metebelis 3 where he must face the spider ruler, the Great One. But it is an encounter that he may not survive.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E1 — Robot: Part 1 UNIT are called in when top secret plans and valuable equipment is stolen from high security establishments. The newly regenerated Doctor suggests that the thief may not be human.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E2 — Robot: Part 2 Using the deadly disintegrator weapon, the robot steals the destructor codes. Harry Sullivan is sent to infiltrate Think Tank to discover the truth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E3 — Robot: Part 3 Sealed inside an underground bunker, Miss Winters issues her demands to the world’s leaders, threatening a devastating nuclear strike if her demands are not met.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E4 — Robot: Part 4 The Doctor races to avert a nuclear holocaust. The robot, distraught over killing its creator, takes Sarah hostage and goes on a rampage.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E6 — The Ark in Space: Part 2 When the Doctor restores the power to the Ark, the humans begin to revive. But the station has been invaded by the giant insectoid Wirrn.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E7 — The Ark in Space: Part 3 The Doctor subjects himself to a dangerous experiment so that he can access the memories of the dead Wirrn Queen. Elsewhere, the larvae Wirrn are pupating into their adult form.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E8 — The Ark in Space: Part 4 The mutated Noah has now fully transformed into a Wirrn adult and intends to allow the Wirrn to devour the sleeping humans, absorbing their memories and knowledge.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E9 — The Sontaran Experiment: Part 1 The Doctor, Harry and Sarah find Earth is an empty wilderness. They meet a group of stranded human colonists who are being hunted by a robot and experimented upon by its master.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E10 — The Sontaran Experiment: Part 2 Sarah has been captured by the Sontaran, Field Major Styre who is conducting cruel experiments on the captured humans, paving the way for a full-scale invasion.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E11 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 1 The Time Lords send the Doctor, Sarah and Harry to Skaro at a point in time shortly before the creation of the Daleks. The Doctor's mission is to destroy his greatest enemy.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E12 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 2 The Doctor finds that some of Davros’s fellow Kaleds are unhappy with the development of the Daleks. Sarah is forced to load a Thal war rocket with radioactive explosives.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E13 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 3 The Doctor informs the Kaled government of Davros’s experiments and they move to shut down the bunker. But Davros is one step ahead and prepares to take drastic action.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E14 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 4 When the Kaled dome is destroyed by the Thals’ rocket, the war appears to be over and the Thals rejoice at their victory. But then, the Daleks appear and a massacre begins.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E15 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 5 With Harry and Sarah his prisoners, Davros interrogates the Doctor, forcing him to reveal the future of the Daleks so that he can learn from their defeats to make them stronger.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E16 — Genesis of the Daleks: Part 6 The Kaled scientific elite move to prevent the development of the Daleks while the Doctor prepares to destroy them forever. But is it already too late?
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E17 — Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 1 The Doctor, Sarah and Harry return to Nerva, but at an earlier point in time. The crew are dying from a space plague but the Doctor suspects a survivor may be responsible.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E18 — Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 2 Sarah is the latest victim of the space plague and the only way to cure her is by transmatting her down to the surface of the mysterious planetoid, Voga.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S12 E19 — Revenge of the Cybermen: Part 3 The Cybermen who are intent on destroying Voga. The Doctor and two of the Nerva crew become walking bombs which they Cybermen will detonate once they reach their target.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
